from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIncomeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company report regarding Investment Income."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the metric in the report, e.g., '投资收益'")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the Investment Income")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used in the report, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the data covers, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investment_income_records: list[CompanyIncomeRecord]
